observations: The machine is sitting on a tiled floor with a foot pedal and power cord.
The machine body shows significant surface wear and dirt.
The control panel features a needle height dial, stitch length dial, and a stitch selector dial.
A small metal plate is visible on the machine bed, but its text is illegible.
The machine is not powered on; the needle is not engaged.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a foot pedal and no electric power plug.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: The needle height or stitch length may be incorrect or the mechanism may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine adjusting the needle height and setting the stitch length.

risks.risk: The internal mechanism (e.g., the bobbin case) may be damaged.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bobbin area and the underside of the machine.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Photo of the bobbin area and the underside of the machine.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
